annotations.title: Faith in the ſame.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> This faith is not an other in ſubſtance then the common faith in Chriſt, but is of an other accidental qualitie onely, that is, of more feruor, deuotiõ, zeale, and confident truſt, ſpecially for doing of miracles.

annotations.title: If the foote.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> The Church is of exceding great diſtinctiõ of members, giftes, orders, and offices: yet of great concord, concurrence, mutual communion and participation in al actions of her members among them ſelues, and vvith Chriſt the head of the Body.

annotations.title: Schiſme in the body.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> As Charitie and vnitie of ſpirit, is the proper bond and vveale of the common Body: ſo is diuiſion or Schiſme, vvhich is the interruption of peace and mutual Societie betvvene the partes of the ſame, the ſpecial plague of the Church, and as odious to God as rebellion to the temporal Soueraine.
